steps.description:
Set this first. The COVA Pre-Employment section further down only appears for the company picked in Cova Clinic Settings — until the company matches, the whole block stays hidden and the rest of this tour has nothing to point at.

An offer for any other company is simply not part of the clinic scheme, and none of the COVA rules apply to it.
steps.label: Company
steps.title: 1. Pick the clinic company

steps.description: Choose the Job Applicant this offer is for. Their name, email, designation and phone number are carried onto the offer automatically — the phone number is the one COVA is given, so nobody has to retype it.
steps.label: Job Applicant
steps.title: 2. Link the applicant

steps.description: The day the offer goes out. Mandatory on every Job Offer, COVA or not.
steps.label: Offer Date
steps.title: 3. Offer Date — required

steps.description: Prefilled from the applicant, and mandatory. It is also what the statutory test sweep matches on later — sprayers get cholinesterase, kitchen and dairy staff get food handler — so it is worth being accurate.
steps.label: Designation
steps.title: 4. Designation — required

steps.description:
Mandatory for offers of the clinic company. COVA identifies a pre-employment candidate by National ID — it is the key the wellness result comes back on, and registration is refused outright without it.

The rule is checked twice: the asterisk stops you saving without it, and the offer is checked again when it is saved, so it cannot slip through.
steps.label: National ID
steps.title: 5. National ID (required)

steps.description:
Mandatory too, and already filled in from the Job Applicant if they had one on file. Overwrite it if the candidate gave a different number.

Whatever you type is stored as-is and normalised to +254… on the way out to COVA, so 0740781289 and +254 740 781 289 reach them as the same number.
steps.label: Phone Number
steps.title: 6. Phone Number (required, prefilled)

steps.description: Optional, but both are sent to COVA as part of the candidate's biodata and appear on the test request. Fill them where you have them — the clinic uses them to match the person who turns up.
steps.label: Date of Birth
steps.title: 7. Date of Birth and Gender

steps.description:
That is everything you fill in. The rest of the COVA block — Cova Registered?, Cova Tested? and Linked Test Result — is read-only and fills itself in as the candidate moves through the clinic.

Where you go next: press Save, then use Clinic › Register & Request Wellness. That enrols the candidate on COVA as a pre-employment member and raises the test request in one step.

When COVA answers, Linked Test Result here points at the Clinic Test Result — check its Clinical Outcome before confirming the offer.
steps.label: Date of Birth
steps.title: 8. Where the candidate goes next
